name: Tonkin bamboo screen
metaTitle: Tonkin Bamboo Screen & Room Divider — Wholesale
cardDesc: Folding Tonkin cane screen in a wood frame, 120 × 180 cm.
lead: A folding bamboo screen of straight Tonkin canes in a wooden frame: three hinged panels, 120 × 180 cm, in natural or carbonized bamboo.
desc: Three hinged panels of slim, even Tonkin bamboo canes, set upright in a wooden frame. It stands on its own, folds flat for storage and shipping, and works as a room divider, a privacy screen on a balcony or terrace, or a backdrop in shops, hotels and restaurants.
why: Choose it when you need privacy without fixing anything: it stands on its own, folds away, and the straight Tonkin canes give a finer, more furniture-like look than a rolled garden fence.

spec.v: Natural Tonkin bamboo poles (grown 3+ years), wooden frame

sizes.title: Standard size
sizes.lead: One standard size in two finishes; other sizes on request.
sizes.note: Custom widths, heights and panel counts are made to order; ask us for a quote.

body.p: Tonkin bamboo is one of the strongest and most flexible bamboo species. Its canes grow slim, straight and even, and the bamboo is naturally bitter, which makes it less attractive to insects. We use poles that have grown for at least three years, so the screens are firm and keep their shape.

The canes stand upright side by side inside a wooden frame, split into three panels joined by hinges. Open it in a zig-zag and it stands by itself; fold it up and it lies flat, which also keeps freight costs down.

ul: Room dividers in homes, studios and offices
Privacy screens on balconies, terraces and covered patios
Backdrops and space dividers in shops, hotels, spas and restaurants

body.p: A rolled bamboo fence is fixed to an existing fence or frame and is made for the garden boundary. The Tonkin screen is a finished, free-standing piece: finer canes, a framed edge and hinges, so it moves around and works indoors as well as out. Choose natural for a light, warm look, or carbonized for a deeper brown tone that runs through the cane.

faq.q: Is this a fence or a room divider?
faq.a: It is a free-standing folding screen. It works as a room divider indoors and as a privacy screen on a balcony, terrace or covered patio. For a garden boundary, choose one of our bamboo fence rolls or fixed panels instead.
The standard screen is 120 cm wide, 180 cm high and 5 cm thick, made of three hinged panels, with a net weight of 22 kg. Other sizes are made to order.
Yes, in a sheltered spot such as a covered terrace or balcony. Like all natural bamboo it lasts longest when it is kept off wet ground and out of standing water.
Each screen is wrapped in plastic foam and the screens are loaded on pallets. Private-label packaging, labels and barcodes are available on request.
